title: Isha:
title_short: Isha · It's Okay to Not Be Happy
headline: Asked if she is happy, a stranger says no, and that it is okay.
story: An Are You Happy street interview. One person, one honest answer. Nick asks Isha: are you happy? Not really. She just broke up with her boyfriend. “I don't think the goal is to be happy, just to experience and to live.”

Watsi comes in near the end, in her own words: minutes before, she was given $10 to help pay for a stranger's surgery. It ends on her message to the world: “Don't wait to start living.” Honest and light. Never sad.
do: Open on frame 1 with “Are you happy?” on top. No fade, no logo.
Put each of Nick's questions on screen as top text.
Keep picture cuts to 3–4. Audio cuts are free.
dont: No gift-card reveal story. That is the compilation video.
No joke text or emoji on the break-up line.
Do not use “the same as this building” or “I just chose the first one”. They belong to the compilation.
